A RESOLUTION OF THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN TO AUTHORIZE THE ENFORCEMENT OF THE RIGHTS OF THE TOWN TO ITS RIGHT- OF-WAYS AND OTHER PROPERTY

WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain (the “Town”) holds title and possesses an interest in certain real property and right-of-ways within the Town (the “Property”); and

WHEREAS, in the past, the Town has inconsistently enforced its rights under applicable law to prohibit trespass and encroachment onto its Property; and

WHEREAS, the Town desires, from this day forward, to consistently enforce and police its property rights in its Property; and

WHEREAS, due to past inconsistent enforcement, the Town desires to notify the public and all interested parties of its renewed intent to enforce its rights in the Property.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN that:

L The Town shall hereinafter protect and defend its property boundaries from encroachment or other trespass, as determined by the Town Council.

- 2. The Town does not have a present intention of requiring the removal of existing encroachments from Town Property, but expressly reserves all of its rights with respect to any existing trespass or encroachment, including, without limitation, its right to require the removal of any and all encroachments at the expense of the owner of such encroachment at a later date, with or without subsequent resolution or notice, except as otherwise required by applicable law.

RESOLVED by the Mayor and Council of the TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN this 9" day of May, 2022.
